input.title: ZM Beta Player Messages – Team Note (Oct 1 2025)
input.bodyText:
ZM Beta Player Messages – what we actually say to players
Samuel Turner, Oct 1 2025. Calls follow the Beta message rule; the full row-by-row list is in the sheet "ZM Beta Player Messages – Calls (Oct 1 2025)" in the same folder.

1. Where retention stands: Sep 15 cohort week (warehouse, USER_COHORT_RETENTION, Zombie Match 3D)
- iOS: 237 installs, D1 31.65%, D7 9.28%
- Android: 103 installs, D1 37.86%, D7 10.68%

2. Result: 32 messages (14 PN sheet rows + 18 asks filed on tickets). Go 2, Hold 24, Drop 6.
The PN sheet says 6 are Ready. Only 2 pass all six tests today: Lapsed 1 day (DES-316) and Lapsed 7 days (DES-317). Lapsed 7 days ships with Leonard's new headline "Your Squad Needs You Back" (string ticket DES-346; the client still has "They've Taken Over… Can You Stop Them?"). Both Go items are on the checklist on the Push Notifications card for Vincent.

3. Lapsed reminders the client schedules, day by day (NotificationManager.cs, rescheduled every time the game closes, counted from the server date of the last session)
- Day 1: "The Horde Is Growing… 🧟‍♂️" (Lapsed 1 day)
- Day 7: "They've Taken Over… Can You Stop Them? 😱" (Lapsed 7 days; becomes "Your Squad Needs You Back" with DES-346)
- Day 14: same message as day 7
- Day 21: same message as day 7
- Day 28: same message as day 7
- Nothing on days 2–6, 8–13, and so on, and nothing after day 28. A day-3 reminder (DES-342) and a day-30 reminder (DES-343) are Hold (test 3: not scheduled). A day-14 reminder (DES-344) is Drop because the day-7 batch already fires on day 14.
- Only players who've had our own permission ask (after level 20) or who switched notifications on in settings get any of these. The iOS launch popup doesn't switch anything on.

4. Already scheduled by the client but still Hold, and why
- Lives recharged / Full Ammo Reloaded (DES-315): test 6. Vincent took his tick off on Sep 30; it didn't arrive on the iOS 0.3.49 store build after a full refill. Seen on Android only.
- Plague Race start (DES-319): test 6. The iOS tick came from a shortened-timer build, which doesn't count; on real 0.3.40 it never arrived on iOS. Android only.
- Weekly Leaderboard reset (DES-320): test 5. It fires 7/14/21/28 days after the last session instead of on the weekly reset day, which comes from the server and is the same for everyone.
- Finish first mission (DES-318): test 4. It targets players below level 20, but our permission ask only runs after level 20 (Robert's call stands), so it can't reach anyone it's written for.

5. Everything else
- Hold, test 3 (feature is in the beta, client could send it, not scheduled yet): Quests rollover, Login Calendar, Season Pass start, Win & Collect start (DES-313), Endless entries back, Boss Arena open, Boss Arena last hours, Season Pass last 48h, Plague Race last hour, Zombie Lane reward, Achievement reward, Daily chest, Free shop coins, Lapsed 3 days, Lapsed 30 days.
- Hold, test 2 (needs a server send): Endless weekly result, Season Pass premium nudge, Plague Race result, Support reply waiting, New levels added.
- Drop, test 1 (not in the beta): Hourly Coins, Nathan's Treasure Hunt, Streak Fever, Axe Arena, Comeback gift on tap. Drop, already covered: Lapsed 14 days (covered by Lapsed 7 days).

Ticket moves: Drop tickets are Canceled. Hold tickets are back in Backlog and unassigned, per the BETA list rule that nothing non-beta-ready sits in Todo until the beta build is out. Go tickets stay as they are.
